knowledge.notes: The release is a projection (lakeId, name, state, lat, lon) of the Engine's compiled lake directory, the registry.lakes contract; a test fails when it drifts from Sources/SectorEngine/Support/LakeDirectory.swift. The ephemeris is code (sector-moon-v1), not knowledge.

operations.internalExecution: none: not scheduled (control manifest PARKED, executionTarget kind none) and absent from the execution control (disabled). Prepared, inert: the gated live writer (run.py --write refuses without an APPROVED release and MOON_WRITE_APPROVED=1), brains/moon/deploy/ (refuses without the owner's deploy approval; creates no scheduler) and the orchestrator's planned moon-brain executor (joins only when the manifest target is switched on). Turning it on: MOON_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 7.1.

execution.refresh: after each Weather run: the control manifest gives Moon the DEPENDENCY_CHANGED trigger on its OPTIONAL weather edge (deferIfUpstreamStarted false) and Weather's fingerprint includes lastSuccessfulRun, so once both are enabled every completed Weather run makes Moon due at the next hourly grant, reading Weather's last completed states (generated within 3 h). Inert today: Moon is PARKED (DEPENDENCY_CHANGED is SKIP_PARKED) and absent from the execution control (docs/brains/MOON_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 7.1)
